grants.unknownEntry: No content entry has the id {entry}.
grants.cycle: {count, plural, one {{entries} grants itself} other {{entries} grant one another in a loop}}.
grants.tooDeep: This grant is more than {maximum} steps from the character, so it is not followed.
grants.pickNotOffered: {value} is not one of the options {entry} offers, so the choice is open again.
grants.unknownChoice: {entry} grants the pick for {flag}, but has no choice by that name.
grants.pickNotEntry: The pick {value} for {flag} is an option, not a content entry, so it cannot be granted.
grants.oscillates: {count, plural, one {{entries} keeps} other {{entries} keep}} switching on and off, because a grant or roll option undoes what it depends on, so {count, plural, one {it is} other {they are}} left out.
grants.tooManyRounds: Grants did not settle within {maximum} rounds, so {entries} {count, plural, one {is} other {are}} left out.
